reg-sz-keeps-percent-literal: quick 261128-810: a REG_SZ value is read literally, as Windows reads it, and only a REG_EXPAND_SZ value has its %VAR% expanded; the TS that recorded golden/windows (94-07) expanded REG_SZ too, but this case's single percent sign is literal under both rules, so its recorded folder replays unchanged; the delta is a second arm, the recorded stdout with the REG_SZ data plus \10%, which holds the pair %\Desktop\10% that the recorded TS read as the unset variable \Desktop\10 and answered undefined, where the port answers the data itself; the TS oracle was deleted in 94-24, so the case is never re-recorded and this delta is its record
